description: The Sound role's profile for a session film: a mid-tempo bed whose quiet bars are the wait for the answer and whose drop is the result landing, a few effects on the session's own events (the full stop, send, the tool call, the result, a mark, the flood into the end card), and room for a voice-over that lowers the bed under each line. A film must work muted: the captions tell the story.

tempo.session: 25 to 30 s at 118 to 128 BPM: the prompt is typed over about 8 beats, the wait for the answer is two bars, the result lands on the drop
tempo.longer: a session with a longer answer adds beats to the answer, never to the wait: a drawn session's wait is music, not a claim about the product's speed

structure: sound on frame 0, two quiet bars before the drop under the tool call, the drop on the result, a fade of about 1.6 s as the end card settles
fit: beats.py <track> --bpm <intended> --drop-beat <the result's beat>: the fitted tempo and the music.start that puts the drop on that beat

recorded.measured: 123.64 BPM; its drop at 15.653 s, two quiet bars before it; start 4.006 puts the drop on film beat 24, where the starter's result lands

music.generated: Optional. Higgsfield MCP generate_audio when its catalog lists a music model: get_cost first, show the price, wait for a yes, then one run. Fit the result with beats.py and trust the fit, never the prompt.

pop.note: the hook's full stop pops; the end card's mark closes

whoosh.note: the full stop grows into the window

click.note: send: the prompt leaves the composer

result.note: the answer's card lands, on the drop

mark.note: a line is drawn around a region

flood.note: the pill floods into the end card, placed by its peak

voice: Optional, one line per caption or so, in cues.json's voice.<lang>; speak.mjs and voice.mjs (references/session.md) duck the bed under each line and master to -14 LUFS

levels.sfx: each effect is normalised to -1 dBFS before its gain, so a gain says where it sits against the others

gate: earshot critique on the encoded file; fix every [critical] and [major], or write down why a line stays
